title: Google login works in preview but fails on real domain
description:
Google login works in the preview and breaks on your real domain. Google only sends users back to redirect URLs you registered. A new domain that is not on the list is rejected, and the builder's preview URL is usually the only one registered.

Built your app with Lovable, Bolt, v0 or Replit and it keeps breaking? Get it audited: https://rescue.codeaz.org
